module_summary: Destination half of a CDC FIFO: a local read pointer indexes the source-side data array, valid derives from comparing it to a write pointer received via a 2-phase CDC, and the read pointer is sent back via another 2-phase CDC.

anchors.name: dst_rptr_q
anchors.why: Read pointer advanced on each pop; indexes data array and is sent to source.

anchors.name: dst_wptr
anchors.why: Write pointer received through 2-phase CDC; compared for non-empty.

anchors.name: dst_valid_o
anchors.why: Output valid when read and write pointers differ (FIFO not empty).

anchors.name: dst_ready_i
anchors.why: Consumer ready; with valid advances the read pointer.

anchors.name: dst_data_o
anchors.why: Output data selected from async data array by read index.

anchors.name: async_data_i
anchors.why: Source-domain FIFO storage contents, read asynchronously by read index.

anchors.name: fifo_ridx
anchors.why: Lower read-pointer bits indexing the async data array.

anchors.name: fifo_rdata
anchors.why: Selected FIFO entry driven to dst_data_o.

anchors.name: async_wptr_req_i
anchors.why: 2-phase request toggling with each new write pointer from source.

anchors.name: async_rptr_req_o
anchors.why: 2-phase request carrying read pointer back to source.

anchors.name: async_rptr_ack_i
anchors.why: 2-phase ack from source for read pointer transfer.

anchors.name: async_wptr_data_i
anchors.why: Write pointer payload of incoming 2-phase CDC.

anchors.name: async_rptr_data_o
anchors.why: Read pointer payload of outgoing 2-phase CDC.

groups.name: read_side
groups.description: Read pointer, empty compare and indexed read of async data array.

groups.name: wptr_cdc_rx
groups.description: 2-phase CDC receiving write pointer from source domain.

groups.name: rptr_cdc_tx
groups.description: 2-phase CDC sending read pointer back to source domain.
